summary: Comprehensive LINK/ROUTE sweep for LeaderOS Iter 92.25 (post /signup + /register addition). Tested 18 authenticated routes, 5 redirect routes, wildcard catch-all (auth + unauth), 4 public legal pages, 8 auth-gated unauth redirects, FloatingWladBotDrawer visibility on 7 routes, footer legal hrefs on 4 authed pages, and Stripe pricing regression (€444.700 must NOT appear; €4.797 expected). Result: ALL 18 authenticated routes resolve to a non-blank, error-free page (no white-screens, no chunk-404, no error boundaries, 0 page errors). /signup + /register correctly render register form with 'Account erstellen' heading. Phone-OR-email field shows 'E-Mail oder Telefon' label. Auth-gated routes correctly redirect to /login when unauth. Wildcard /this-does-not-exist-xyz → /login (unauth) / /dashboard (auth). FloatingWladBotDrawer (data-testid='wladbot-fab') correctly HIDDEN on /chat (only separate 'wladhelp-fab' present there) and SHOWN on dashboard, coaching, lern-videos, profile, community, missions. Stripe regression PASS: €4.797 present on /coaching, €444.700 absent everywhere. ONE MINOR DEVIATION from spec: /referrals does NOT redirect to /referral — it has its own ProtectedRoute rendering ReferralPage at /referrals URL (App.js:149); functionally identical page but URL not normalized.

route_issues.actual: Renders ReferralPage at /referrals URL directly (App.js line 149 is a ProtectedRoute, not a Navigate)
route_issues.user_impact: None — page renders correctly, link is not broken. Only URL normalization differs from spec.
route_issues.fix_hint: Replace App.js:149 `<Route path="/referrals" element={<ProtectedRoute><ReferralPage /></ProtectedRoute>} />` with `<Route path="/referrals" element={<Navigate to="/referral" replace />} />` to match /settings, /progress, /video-challenge, /learning-videos redirect pattern.

unauth_routes./signup_renders_register: PASS (Account erstellen + Login + 1:1 Coaching labels present)
unauth_routes.public_legal_pages: PASS (impressum/datenschutz/widerruf/agb all render H1 without auth)

floating_wladbot_drawer_data_testid_wlad./chat: HIDDEN (correct — only separate 'wladhelp-fab' WladHelp button present, NOT WladBot)

tests_executed.login_test_at_test_dot_com: PASS (200 OK on /api/auth/login, navigated to /dashboard, auth persists across all 18 authed routes via httpOnly cookie)

console_errors_observed: 401 on /api/some/endpoint and 403 on a different one during auth-route sweep — NOT chunk-load or routing errors; appear to be feature-data 401/403 noise unrelated to routing. Did not cause white-screens or break navigation.
action_items: MINOR: Convert /referrals from `<Route>` rendering ReferralPage to `<Navigate to='/referral' replace />` in App.js:149 to match spec (and the consistent pattern used for /settings, /progress, /video-challenge, /learning-videos). Currently page renders correctly so user impact is zero, but URL is not normalized as test request specified.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js currently has 200+ lines and many lazy-loaded routes — clean. ProtectedRoute pattern correct. /signup + /register addition (App.js:115-116) correctly passes initialMode='register' to LoginPage.
FloatingWladBotDrawer hidden-routes filter correctly suppresses on /chat (uses separate 'wladhelp-fab' there). No conflict between the two FABs.

Public legal routes (impressum/datenschutz/widerruf/agb) correctly placed ABOVE the wildcard `<Route path='*' element={<Navigate to='/dashboard' replace />} />` at App.js:165 so they remain accessible without auth. Verified — all 4 render their H1 unauthenticated.
Consider normalizing /referrals (App.js:149) to a Navigate redirect for URL hygiene and consistency with other aliases.

success_rate.frontend: 97% — 35/36 link assertions pass; only /referrals URL normalization differs from spec

test_credentials: test@test.com / test123 (admin, auth via httpOnly cookie working — token NOT in localStorage which is correct per Iter 92.24 security design)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 92.25 link sweep — all 18 protected routes, redirects, wildcards, public legal pages, FAB visibility, footer links, and Stripe pricing regression verified. Only deviation: /referrals not normalized to /referral (App.js:149). data-testids in use: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-btn, register-email-input, register-phone-input, register-submit-btn, wladbot-fab (FloatingWladBotDrawer), wladhelp-fab (separate WladHelp button, present on /chat). Phone-OR-Email login confirmed via 'E-Mail oder Telefon' label on /login.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no critical bugs found. Sole deviation (/referrals not redirecting) is a missed alias-normalization in App.js:149 where the developer added a parallel ProtectedRoute instead of a `<Navigate replace>` like the other 4 redirect aliases. One-line fix as noted in action_items.
